resources.string: Export or restore everything in one file

One file with your cars (VIN, ECU list, last detection and fault read), every profile with its phone and Android Auto pages and its graphs, and the settings. Keep it off the phone (computer, cloud) to get everything back after a reinstall.
Replaces the cars, profiles, graphs and settings of the phone with those of the file. All or nothing: if something goes wrong, the phone stays as it was.
Backup of %1$s (version %2$s). Cars: %3$d, profiles: %4$d, graphs: %5$d. The cars, profiles and settings now on the phone will be replaced. The app disconnects from the car first.
The file holds the VIN of your cars (unlike a shared profile file): it is your private backup, do not share it.
No API token, Telegraf token or password is ever in it: enter the Telegraf token again after a reinstall.
Not in it either: the ECU files (import the Ecu folder again), the recording and translation folders picked on the phone, the recordings and the Telegraf queue.
Also through the Local API: GET /api/v1/backup and POST /api/v1/backup/restore (scope config).
Import the ECU files if the phone has none (Settings › Tools › Tool32).
Enter the Telegraf token or password again (Settings › Telegraf export).
Pick the translation folder again (Settings › Translations).
Recordings go to the default folder: pick yours again in Settings › Recording if you had chosen one.
